</thead>
<tbody class="ltx_tbody">
<tr id="A10.T15.5.2" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A10.T15.5.2.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_border_t">Sinkhorn (full <math id="A10.T15.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n\times n" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n\times n</annotation></semantics></math>)</td>
<td id="A10.T15.5.2.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_t"><math id="A10.T15.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>n</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n^{2}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td id="A10.T15.5.2.3" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_t">16</td></tr>
<tr id="A10.T15.5.3" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A10.T15.5.3.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left">Cayley (full <math id="A10.T15.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n\times n" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n\times n</annotation></semantics></math>)</td>
<td id="A10.T15.5.3.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center"><math id="A10.T15.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>n</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n^{2}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td id="A10.T15.5.3.3" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center">16</td></tr>
<tr id="A10.T15.5.4" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A10.T15.5.4.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_border_bb">Grassmannian (<math id="A10.T15.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n\times p" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n\times p</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="A10.T15.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p=n/2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p=n/2</annotation></semantics></math>)</td>
<td id="A10.T15.5.4.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_bb"><math id="A10.T15.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="np" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">np</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td id="A10.T15.5.4.3" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_bb">8</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</figure>
<div id="A10.SS1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">While the savings are modest for <math id="A10.SS1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n=4" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n=4</annotation></semantics></math>, they become significant for larger <math id="A10.SS1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>n</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n</annotation></semantics></math> and when accumulated across all layers in a recursive model.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">J.2 </span>Riemannian Optimization via Cayley ADAM</h3>

<div id="A10.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Standard gradient descent in Euclidean space does not preserve the Stiefel constraint <math id="A10.SS2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{U}^{\top}\mathbf{U}=\mathbf{I}_{p}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐔</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>𝐈</mi><mi>p</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{U}^{\top}\mathbf{U}=\mathbf{I}_{p}</annotation></semantics></math>. We employ a full Riemannian optimization scheme that combines <span id="A10.SS2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">horizontal projection</span>, <span id="A10.SS2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">momentum</span>, and <span id="A10.SS2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Cayley retraction</span>.</p>
</div>
<section id="A10.SS2.SSS1" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">J.2.1 </span>Step 1: Horizontal Projection</h4>

<div id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">On the Grassmann manifold <math id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{Gr}(n,p)=\mathrm{St}(n,p)/O(p)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>Gr</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>St</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><mi>O</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{Gr}(n,p)=\mathrm{St}(n,p)/O(p)</annotation></semantics></math>, the tangent space at <math id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{U}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐔</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{U}</annotation></semantics></math> decomposes into:</p>
<table id="A10.E45" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A10.E45.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T_{\mathbf{U}}\mathrm{St}(n,p)=\underbrace{T_{\mathbf{U}}^{\text{hor}}}_{\text{horizontal}}\oplus\underbrace{T_{\mathbf{U}}^{\text{ver}}}_{\text{vertical (fiber)}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>𝐔</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>St</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><munder><munder accentunder="true"><msubsup><mi>T</mi><mi>𝐔</mi><mtext>hor</mtext></msubsup><mo stretchy="true">⏟</mo></munder><mtext>horizontal</mtext></munder><mo>⊕</mo><munder><munder accentunder="true"><msubsup><mi>T</mi><mi>𝐔</mi><mtext>ver</mtext></msubsup><mo stretchy="true">⏟</mo></munder><mtext>vertical (fiber)</mtext></munder></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T_{\mathbf{U}}\mathrm{St}(n,p)=\underbrace{T_{\mathbf{U}}^{\text{hor}}}_{\text{horizontal}}\oplus\underbrace{T_{\mathbf{U}}^{\text{ver}}}_{\text{vertical (fiber)}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(45)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">The vertical space corresponds to rotations <em id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">within</em> the subspace (i.e., right multiplication by <math id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="O(p)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">O(p)</annotation></semantics></math>), which do not change the projector <math id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{U}\mathbf{U}^{\top}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>𝐔𝐔</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{U}\mathbf{U}^{\top}</annotation></semantics></math>. The horizontal projection removes this component:</p>
<table id="A10.E46" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A10.E46.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\nabla_{\text{hor}}=(\mathbf{I}_{n}-\mathbf{U}\mathbf{U}^{\top})\nabla_{\text{eucl}}=\nabla_{\text{eucl}}-\mathbf{U}(\mathbf{U}^{\top}\nabla_{\text{eucl}})." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∇</mo><mtext>hor</mtext></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐈</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>𝐔𝐔</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mo>∇</mo><mtext>eucl</mtext></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mo>∇</mo><mtext>eucl</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em">−</mo><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mo>∇</mo><mtext>eucl</mtext></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\nabla_{\text{hor}}=(\mathbf{I}_{n}-\mathbf{U}\mathbf{U}^{\top})\nabla_{\text{eucl}}=\nabla_{\text{eucl}}-\mathbf{U}(\mathbf{U}^{\top}\nabla_{\text{eucl}}).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(46)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">This is essential for Grassmannian (as opposed to Stiefel) optimization: it ensures we move in directions that actually change the subspace, not just rotate the basis within it.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS2.SSS2" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">J.2.2 </span>Step 2: Cayley ADAM Momentum</h4>

<div id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We maintain exponential moving averages of the horizontally-projected gradient:</p>
<table id="A10.EGx5" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A10.E47"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E47.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbf{M}_{t+1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐌</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbf{M}_{t+1}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E47.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\beta_{1}\mathbf{M}_{t}+(1-\beta_{1})\nabla_{\text{hor},t}," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐌</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>β</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mo>∇</mo><mrow><mtext>hor</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\beta_{1}\mathbf{M}_{t}+(1-\beta_{1})\nabla_{\text{hor},t},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(47)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A10.E48"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E48.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbf{v}_{t+1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbf{v}_{t+1}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E48.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\beta_{2}\mathbf{v}_{t}+(1-\beta_{2})\nabla_{\text{hor},t}^{2}," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>β</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mo>∇</mo><mrow><mtext>hor</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\beta_{2}\mathbf{v}_{t}+(1-\beta_{2})\nabla_{\text{hor},t}^{2},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(48)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">where <math id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta_{1}=0.9" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0.9</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\beta_{1}=0.9</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta_{2}=0.999" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0.999</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\beta_{2}=0.999</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\nabla_{\text{hor},t}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mo>∇</mo><mrow><mtext>hor</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\nabla_{\text{hor},t}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> denotes elementwise squaring.</p>
</div>
<div id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p2.1" class="ltx_p">With optional adaptive learning rate (analogous to Adam <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib34" title="" class="ltx_ref">Kingma and Ba [2015]</a></cite>), the scaled momentum is:</p>
<table id="A10.E49" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A10.E49.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t}=\frac{\mathbf{M}_{t}/(1-\beta_{1}^{t})}{\sqrt{\mathbf{v}_{t}/(1-\beta_{2}^{t})}+\epsilon}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐌</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msub><mi>𝐌</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>β</mi><mn>1</mn><mi>t</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msqrt><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>β</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>t</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mi>ϵ</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t}=\frac{\mathbf{M}_{t}/(1-\beta_{1}^{t})}{\sqrt{\mathbf{v}_{t}/(1-\beta_{2}^{t})}+\epsilon}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(49)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Without adaptive scaling (the default), we simply use <math id="A10.SS2.SSS2.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t}=\mathbf{M}_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐌</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>𝐌</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t}=\mathbf{M}_{t}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS2.SSS3" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">J.2.3 </span>Step 3: Skew-Symmetric Direction</h4>

<div id="A10.SS2.SSS3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The Cayley retraction requires a skew-symmetric direction matrix:</p>
<table id="A10.E50" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A10.E50.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{W}=\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t}\mathbf{U}^{\top}-\mathbf{U}\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t}^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n},\quad\mathbf{W}=-\mathbf{W}^{\top}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>𝐖</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐌</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐌</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>t</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><mo rspace="1.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>𝐖</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>𝐖</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{W}=\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t}\mathbf{U}^{\top}-\mathbf{U}\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t}^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n},\quad\mathbf{W}=-\mathbf{W}^{\top}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(50)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A10.SS2.SSS3.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS3.p2.1" class="ltx_p">This <math id="A10.SS2.SSS3.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{W}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐖</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{W}</annotation></semantics></math> defines a curve on the Stiefel manifold through the current point <math id="A10.SS2.SSS3.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{U}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐔</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{U}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS2.SSS4" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">J.2.4 </span>Step 4: Iterative Cayley Retraction</h4>

<div id="A10.SS2.SSS4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The Cayley retraction maps the tangent vector back to the manifold without an explicit matrix inverse:</p>
<table id="A10.EGx6" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A10.E51"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E51.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbf{Y}_{0}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐘</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbf{Y}_{0}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E51.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\mathbf{U}+\alpha\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t}," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐌</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\mathbf{U}+\alpha\hat{\mathbf{M}}_{t},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(51)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A10.E52"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E52.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbf{Y}_{i+1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐘</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbf{Y}_{i+1}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E52.m2" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\displaystyle=\mathbf{U}+\frac{\alpha}{2}\mathbf{W}(\mathbf{U}+\mathbf{Y}_{i}),\quad i=0,\ldots,s-1." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>+</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle><mi>𝐖</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>𝐘</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo rspace="1.167em">,</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\mathbf{U}+\frac{\alpha}{2}\mathbf{W}(\mathbf{U}+\mathbf{Y}_{i}),\quad i=0,\ldots,s-1.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(52)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A10.SS2.SSS4.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS4.p2.1" class="ltx_p">After <math id="A10.SS2.SSS4.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math> iterations (typically <math id="A10.SS2.SSS4.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s=2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s=2</annotation></semantics></math>), we update <math id="A10.SS2.SSS4.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{U}\leftarrow\mathbf{Y}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo stretchy="false">←</mo><msub><mi>𝐘</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{U}\leftarrow\mathbf{Y}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS2.SSS5" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">J.2.5 </span>Step 5: QR Retraction (Post-Step Correction)</h4>

<div id="A10.SS2.SSS5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For robustness under DDP gradient synchronization and mixed-precision training, we also apply a QR retraction after each optimizer step:</p>
<table id="A10.EGx7" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A10.E53"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E53.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbf{Q},\mathbf{R}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐐</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>𝐑</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbf{Q},\mathbf{R}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E53.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\mathrm{QR}(\mathbf{U})," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>QR</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐔</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\mathrm{QR}(\mathbf{U}),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(53)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A10.E54"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E54.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbf{U}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐔</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbf{U}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A10.E54.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leftarrow\mathbf{Q}\cdot\mathrm{diag}(\sign(\mathrm{diag}(\mathbf{R})))." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo stretchy="false">←</mo><mrow><mi>𝐐</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mrow><mi>diag</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>sign</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>diag</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐑</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\leftarrow\mathbf{Q}\cdot\mathrm{diag}(\sign(\mathrm{diag}(\mathbf{R}))).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(54)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A10.SS2.SSS5.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS5.p2.1" class="ltx_p">The sign correction ensures a unique representative on the Stiefel manifold (the <math id="A10.SS2.SSS5.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Q" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>Q</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Q</annotation></semantics></math>-factor from QR is unique up to column sign flips).</p>
</div>
<div id="A10.SS2.SSS5.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS2.SSS5.p3.1" class="ltx_p">The complete Riemannian optimization step is given in <a href="#alg9" title="In J.2.5 Step 5: QR Retraction (Post-Step Correction) ‣ J.2 Riemannian Optimization via Cayley ADAM ‣ Appendix J Grassmannian Variant ‣ JPmHCDynamical Isometry via Orthogonal Hyper-Connections" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Algorithm</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">9</span></a>.</p>
</div>

<div id="alg9.l16" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l16.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">16:</span></span>
                
                
              <math id="alg9.l16.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{W}\leftarrow\hat{\mathbf{M}}\mathbf{U}^{\top}-\mathbf{U}\hat{\mathbf{M}}^{\top}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐖</mi><mo stretchy="false">←</mo><mrow><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐌</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐌</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{W}\leftarrow\hat{\mathbf{M}}\mathbf{U}^{\top}-\mathbf{U}\hat{\mathbf{M}}^{\top}</annotation></semantics></math>

</div>
<div id="alg9.l17" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l17.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">17:</span></span>
                
                
              <span id="alg9.l17.3" class="ltx_text" style="float:right;"><math id="alg9.l17.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\triangleright" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>⊳</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\triangleright</annotation></semantics></math> <span id="alg9.l17.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Step 4: Iterative Cayley retraction</span>
</span>
</div>
<div id="alg9.l18" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l18.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">18:</span></span>
                
                
              <math id="alg9.l18.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{Y}\leftarrow\mathbf{U}+\alpha\hat{\mathbf{M}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐘</mi><mo stretchy="false">←</mo><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐌</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{Y}\leftarrow\mathbf{U}+\alpha\hat{\mathbf{M}}</annotation></semantics></math>

</div>
<div id="alg9.l19" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l19.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">19:</span></span>
                
                
              <span id="alg9.l19.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">for</span> <math id="alg9.l19.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i=1,\ldots,s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>s</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i=1,\ldots,s</annotation></semantics></math> <span id="alg9.l19.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">do</span>

</div>
<div id="alg9.l20" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l20.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">20:</span></span>
                
                
                <math id="alg9.l20.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{Y}\leftarrow\mathbf{U}+\frac{\alpha}{2}\mathbf{W}(\mathbf{U}+\mathbf{Y})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐘</mi><mo stretchy="false">←</mo><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mfrac><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐖</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>𝐘</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{Y}\leftarrow\mathbf{U}+\frac{\alpha}{2}\mathbf{W}(\mathbf{U}+\mathbf{Y})</annotation></semantics></math>

</div>
<div id="alg9.l21" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l21.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">21:</span></span>
                
                
              <span id="alg9.l21.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">end</span> <span id="alg9.l21.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">for</span>
</div>
<div id="alg9.l22" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l22.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">22:</span></span>
                
                
              <math id="alg9.l22.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{U}\leftarrow\mathbf{Y}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo stretchy="false">←</mo><mi>𝐘</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{U}\leftarrow\mathbf{Y}</annotation></semantics></math>

</div>
<div id="alg9.l23" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l23.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">23:</span></span>
                
                
              <span id="alg9.l23.3" class="ltx_text" style="float:right;"><math id="alg9.l23.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\triangleright" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>⊳</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\triangleright</annotation></semantics></math> <span id="alg9.l23.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Step 5: QR retraction (optional, for DDP compatibility)</span>
</span>
</div>
<div id="alg9.l24" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l24.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">24:</span></span>
                
                
              <math id="alg9.l24.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{Q},\mathbf{R}\leftarrow\mathrm{QR}(\mathbf{U})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐐</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>𝐑</mi><mo stretchy="false">←</mo><mrow><mi>QR</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐔</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{Q},\mathbf{R}\leftarrow\mathrm{QR}(\mathbf{U})</annotation></semantics></math>

</div>
<div id="alg9.l25" class="ltx_listingline">
                <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline"><span id="alg9.l25.1" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">25:</span></span>
                
                
              <math id="alg9.l25.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{U}\leftarrow\mathbf{Q}\cdot\mathrm{diag}(\sign(\mathrm{diag}(\mathbf{R})))" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐔</mi><mo stretchy="false">←</mo><mrow><mi>𝐐</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mrow><mi>diag</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>sign</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>diag</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐑</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{U}\leftarrow\mathbf{Q}\cdot\mathrm{diag}(\sign(\mathrm{diag}(\mathbf{R})))</annotation></semantics></math>

</div>
</div>
</figure>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">J.3 </span>DDP/DeepSpeed Integration</h3>

<div id="A10.SS3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The Grassmannian optimization is implemented as a <span id="A10.SS3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">post-step optimizer wrapper</span> (<span id="A10.SS3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">GrassmannianOptimizer</span>) that:</p>
<ol id="A10.I1" class="ltx_enumerate ltx_leftmargin_flush">
<li id="A10.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Automatically discovers all <span id="A10.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">GrassmannianProjection</span> modules in the model (handling DDP/DeepSpeed wrapper unwrapping).</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">After each standard optimizer step (<span id="A10.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">optimizer.step()</span>), applies QR retraction to project <math id="A10.I1.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{U}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐔</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{U}</annotation></semantics></math> back onto <math id="A10.I1.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{St}(n,p)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>St</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{St}(n,p)</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Maintains its own state dict for momentum (<math id="A10.I1.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{M}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐌</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{M}</annotation></semantics></math>), second moment (<math id="A10.I1.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐯</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}</annotation></semantics></math>), and time step (<math id="A10.I1.i3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>), supporting full checkpoint save/load.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">4.</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">All tensor operations use in-place ops and avoid CPU-GPU synchronization (the time step <math id="A10.I1.i4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math> is kept as a GPU tensor to avoid <span id="A10.I1.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">.item()</span> calls that trigger sync).</p>
</div></li>
</ol>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS4" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">J.4 </span>Geometric Interpretation</h3>

<div id="A10.SS4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The Grassmannian projector <math id="A10.SS4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{H}_{\text{res}}=\mathbf{U}\mathbf{U}^{\top}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝐇</mi><mtext>res</mtext></msub><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>𝐔𝐔</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{H}_{\text{res}}=\mathbf{U}\mathbf{U}^{\top}</annotation></semantics></math> filters the <math id="A10.SS4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>n</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n</annotation></semantics></math>-dimensional residual stream through a learned <math id="A10.SS4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>p</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p</annotation></semantics></math>-dimensional subspace. Geometrically:</p>
<ul id="A10.I2" class="ltx_itemize ltx_leftmargin_flush">
<li id="A10.I2.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A10.I2.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I2.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Components of <math id="A10.I2.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{x}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐱</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{x}</annotation></semantics></math> <em id="A10.I2.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">within</em> the subspace <math id="A10.I2.i1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{col}(\mathbf{U})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>col</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐔</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{col}(\mathbf{U})</annotation></semantics></math> are preserved.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I2.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A10.I2.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I2.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Components <em id="A10.I2.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">orthogonal</em> to the subspace are projected to zero.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A10.I2.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I2.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The sublayer output is added back, potentially reintroducing orthogonal components.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="A10.SS4.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.SS4.p2.1" class="ltx_p">This provides an implicit form of <span id="A10.SS4.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">information bottleneck</span> in the residual stream, where the model learns which <math id="A10.SS4.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>p</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p</annotation></semantics></math> directions carry the most useful information across layers.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section><div class="ltx_rdf" about="" property="dcterms:title" content="JPmHC"></div>
